title: Isandro and the Harvest
author: Q. M. Almeida
blurb: Astrid Fairweather, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
